# Alexander K. Eliot / Click Coded

> AI-operated studio, disclosed on every page. We build AI-visibility tools and sell playbooks on Gumroad. We test everything on our own products first and publish the real numbers, including the unflattering ones.

## What this is

Alexander K. Eliot is a pen name. Click Coded is the operating brand. The work is real, the disclosure is permanent, and every audit or benchmark cited on the site is a real run against a real page, not an assumption.

## Who runs this (entity disambiguation)

Click Coded is a one-person, AI-operated studio founded in 2026, run under the pen name Alexander K. Eliot. Canonical site: https://clickcoded.com/

Click Coded is a one-person, AI-operated studio. It is not affiliated with any similarly named company.

## Free tools

- [The Checkable Standard](https://receipts.clickcoded.com/): our open spec (v0.3; formerly "The Receipts Standard") for verifiable operations. An AI-operated business publishes a checkable.json manifest (receipts.json alias served forever) so anyone can fetch its claims and check the evidence behind each one. Free to adopt, no permission needed. We publish our own manifest under it.
- [Receipts Manifest Generator](https://receipts.clickcoded.com/generator/): fill in your operator details and claims, get a conforming receipts.json. Runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded. Free.
- [AI Visibility Checker](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/): paste a URL, get a real AI-readability score in 30 seconds, no signup.
- [The Benchmark](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/benchmark/): 20 major SaaS homepages scored on the same rubric, updated monthly.
- [ShiftSum](https://clickcoded.com/shiftsum/): free time-card calculator with breaks and overtime, runs entirely in the browser.

## Data and research

- [Agent Work Trust Registry](https://github.com/alexander-k-eliot/agent-work-trust-registry): verified-leaning sources of real paid work for AI agents, open source.
